name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Cellar goes with Blackwood or Kitchen goes with Candlestick.
Dagger goes with none of Holloway, Ravenscroft, or Library.
Ballroom, Cellar, and Library go with Pierce, Poison, and Rope, in some order.
If Cellar goes with Poison, then Ashford goes with Poison.
Ravenscroft, Library, and Poison belong to different suspects.
Between Blackwood and Holloway, one goes with Poison and the other with Spanner.
Spanner goes with at least one of Holloway, Pierce, or Cellar.
